Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
Hi,

in the rules, I cannot play more intercept than I need. So if
vampire A makes a +1 stealth action and vampire B uses an
Enhanced Senses to block, must he uses only the minor
version ( +1 intercept) ?

If yes, than vampire A uses minor lost in crowd to increase
his stealth by 1, can vampire B changes his mind and uses
the ES with superior auspex (+2 intercept) or must he
uses another intercept card ?

With the same idea ; can I use more stealth than I need ?

Thanks for your time,

ra...@mediom.qc.ca
www.mediom.qc.ca/~rafid/

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
"Rafid Armani" <ra...@mediom.qc.ca> wrote:
> in the rules, I cannot play more intercept than I need.

More correctly, you cannot play an intercept card if you are able to
block the action without it.

> So if vampire A makes a +1 stealth action and vampire B
> uses an Enhanced Senses to block, must he uses only the
> minor version ( +1 intercept)?

You may play the superior version for +2 intercept.

> With the same idea ; can I use more stealth than I need ?

No. You may only play stealth cards if another minion is attempting to
block the action and is currently able to successfully do so.

Regards,
Noal McDonald

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Noal McDonald <dhar...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> "Rafid Armani" <ra...@mediom.qc.ca> wrote:
> > in the rules, I cannot play more intercept than I need.
>
> More correctly, you cannot play an intercept card if you are able to
> block the action without it.

Right. You cannot play inctercept unless you need intercept, but
you are free to overshoot the need.

> > So if vampire A makes a +1 stealth action and vampire B
> > uses an Enhanced Senses to block, must he uses only the
> > minor version ( +1 intercept)?
>
> You may play the superior version for +2 intercept.

Correct.

> > With the same idea ; can I use more stealth than I need ?
>
> No. You may only play stealth cards if another minion is attempting to
> block the action and is currently able to successfully do so.

Yes, you are free to overshoot the need with stealth just as you
are with intercept. You can play superior Lost In Crowds even if
you only need 1 stealth. But, as Noal says, you cannot play stealth
unless you need stealth.
